slot_scores.name: sequential_machine_order_constraint
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Does each product need to be processed on all three machines in the fixed sequence Machine 1, then Machine 2, then Machine 3?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether each product follows the fixed machine order 1→2→3, fully covering the hidden constraint.

slot_scores.name: minimize_total_processing_cycle
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the objective to minimize the total time (makespan) until all three products have completed processing on all three machines?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether the objective is makespan, clarifying the otherwise ambiguous total processing cycle objective.

stopping_behavior.rationale: Both P0 hidden slots were resolved early, but the agent continued with repeated, low-value questions about processing times being fixed constants at turns 7, 9, 11, 12, and 13 before stopping.

summary: The agent successfully recovered both P0 hidden facts through direct clarification questions, but it unnecessarily repeated low-value questions about processing-time assumptions after the core modeling facts were already resolved.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
